kicker: Free chapter book for new readers
headline: A real story. Help on every word.
sub: Stuck on a word? Tap it, and its sound buttons pop up so they can sound it out.
title: A free chapter book with sound buttons on every word
description: Yara Reads is a free chapter book app for kids who just learned their phonics sounds. Every word can be sounded out, and when they get stuck they tap the word to see its sound buttons, with a dot for one letter and a bar for letter pairs like oo and er, just like in class. Works on any tablet. No ads, no account.

headline: What to read after Teach Your Monster to Read
sub: A free dragon chapter book made only of words they can sound out.
title: What to read after Teach Your Monster to Read
description: Finished Teach Your Monster to Read (or Jolly Phonics, Little Wandle, Letters and Sounds) and looking for a real book? Julia and Toby is a free, illustrated, seven-chapter dragon adventure where every word can be sounded out with the phonics sounds and tricky words they already know. Free on any tablet, no account needed.

headline: Decodable books that aren't boring
sub: A runaway dragon whose feelings make things float. 7 illustrated chapters.

title: Decodable books that aren't boring: a free dragon chapter book
description: Most decodable readers are dull. Julia and Toby is a real adventure for kids aged 5 to 7: a runaway dragon whose feelings make things float, and the girl who hides him in her playhouse. Every word can be sounded out. Seven illustrated chapters, free to read in the browser.

headline: Every word can be sounded out

title: A chapter book where every word can be sounded out
description: Each word in Julia and Toby is checked, by how it is said and not just how it is spelled, against the phonics sounds and tricky words a child has learned. Grown-ups can switch sounds on or off to match their child. Free, illustrated, for ages 5 to 7.

headline: A real story they can read on their own

pages.text: Under a tree sits a dragon. He is white, and his scales shine pink and green and blue.
The dragon looks up. A big tear drips down his nose.
"I am Toby," he said. "I ran away from home."

headline: When Toby gets cross, things fly

pages.text: Toby gets cross. His spikes stick up.
And then her dolls zoom up, high, high, high! Her drum zooms up. Her tea set zooms up!
Crash! Bang! Smash! They all come down.
